exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - BO'LIM MUQOVASI.

  Betda faqat bitta yozuv bor:
     PROGRESS TESTS

  Boshqa matn, rasm yoki mashq yo'q.


BUNDAN KEYIN NIMA BO'LADI:

  Workbook oxirida HAR IKKI UNITDAN
  KEYIN bittadan nazorat testi
  beriladi:

     Progress Test 1  - Units 1-2
     Progress Test 2  - Units 3-4
     Progress Test 3  - Units 5-6
     Progress Test 4  - Units 7-8
     Progress Test 5  - Units 9-10
     Progress Test 6  - Units 11-12
     Progress Test 7  - Units 13-14
     Progress Test 8  - yakuniy

  Har testda 'Time: 20 minutes' deb
  yozilgan - test 20 daqiqaga
  mo'ljallangan.


TEST TUZILIShI:

  Boshida to'ldiriladigan
  katakchalar:
     NAME:  (ism)
     CLASS: (sinf)
     DATE:  (sana)
     MARK:  (baho)

  So'ngra bo'limlar:
     • Vocabulary & Grammar
       (lug'at va grammatika):
       'Fill in the missing words'
       (20 ta), 'Choose the correct
       item' (10 ta)
     • Communication (muloqot):
       'Complete the dialogues'
     • ba'zilarida Reading / Writing


⚠ 'PROGRESS TEST' va 'MODULE
SELF-ASSESSMENT' FARQI:

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT -
     Coursebook'da, HAR UCh UNITDAN
     keyin, 100 ball.

  PROGRESS TEST - Workbook'da,
     HAR IKKI UNITDAN keyin, 20
     daqiqa.


QANDAY IShLATISh KERAK:

  1) Ikki unitni tugatgach, testni
     KITOBGA QARAMASDAN yeching.
  2) Vaqtni belgilang - 20 daqiqa.
  3) Keyin javoblarni tekshiring.
  4) Xato qilgan mashq QAYSI QOIDAGA
     oid ekanini toping va o'sha
     betga qayting.

  ⚠ Xatoni tuzatish - testning
  ASOSIY maqsadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  progress   = taraqqiyot, o'sish
  a progress test = nazorat testi
  a mark     = baho
  a class    = sinf
